newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLAND TO HOST TRIANGULAR SERIES IN 1998.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND TO HOST TRIANGULAR SERIES IN 1998.

text.p: England will host a triangular one-day cricket tournament for the first time next year.
South Africa and world champions Sri Lanka are the other teams involved in a four-match competition in August which will feature three qualifying games and a final.

The South Africans will have already played five tests and three one-day internationals against England starting in May, while Sri Lanka have been allocated a solitary test at the Oval at the end of August.

Tim Lamb, chief executive of the English Cricket Board, described it as a "very attractive" programme. He added that England were "delighted that World Cup holders Sri Lanka will be here in the year prior to the 1999 World Cup."
